chrome.signOutBody: You'll need to sign in again. Unsaved work in this session will be lost.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to your operator account
auth.inactivity: You were signed out due to inactivity.
auth.demoSignIn: Sign in with a demo account
auth.resetSubtitle: Enter the email and tenant you sign in with. We'll send a one-time link.
auth.inboxBody: If an account exists for {email} in tenant {tenant}, a one-time reset link is on its way. The link expires in 30 minutes.
auth.inboxTipSpam: Didn't get it? Wait a minute, then check spam.
auth.inboxTipRetry: Still nothing? Confirm the email and tenant, then retry.
auth.passwordUpdatedBody: Sign in with your new password to continue.
auth.linkIncompleteBody: The link is missing a token, email, or tenant. Some email clients clip long URLs — paste the full link from the original email, or request a new one.
auth.verifyingBody: One moment — checking the confirmation token with the server.
auth.emailConfirmedDefault: Your email is confirmed. You can now sign in.
auth.confirmExpiredHint: The link may have expired or already been used. If you've signed in since this email was sent, you can ignore it.
auth.confirmMalformed: This confirmation link is missing required parameters. It may have been clipped by your email client.
auth.demoDescription: Pick a demo account to sign in to the admin console.
auth.demoHint: Tap an account below — we'll fill the credentials and sign you in instantly.
auth.inactivityBody: You've been inactive for a while. We'll sign you out shortly to keep your account secure.
auth.recoveryAudited: Account recovery is rate-limited and audited.
auth.resetExpiry: Reset links expire 30 minutes after issue.

settings.languageDescription: The console and API follow this culture.
settings.themeDescription: Choose a colour mode for the admin console.
settings.densityDescription: Compact mode will reduce padding and row height on data-dense screens.
settings.avatarDesc: Shown in the topbar and on your activity. Square crops work best — JPG, PNG, or WebP.
settings.identityDesc: Your account details. These are managed by an administrator — contact one if changes are needed.
settings.accountStatusDesc: Runtime flags on this account. Contact an operator to change them.
settings.passwordDesc: Used to sign in to this console. Choose a strong, unique passphrase of 16+ characters.
settings.passwordHintSessions: Changing your password does not revoke other sessions automatically — visit the Sessions tab to sign out other devices.
settings.mustDiffer: New password must differ from the current one.
settings.passwordChangedBody: Other active sessions remain valid until you revoke them.
settings.changePasswordDesc: Sign-out events for other devices aren't fired automatically — visit the Sessions tab below to end them after rotating your password.
settings.twoFaEnrollDesc: Adds an authenticator app code on top of your password. Recommended for every operator account.
settings.enrollHint: You'll scan a QR code in your authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy…).
settings.twoFaEnabledBody: Future logins require a 6-digit code from your authenticator.
settings.codeMismatch: That code didn't match. Try again.
settings.twoFaDisableDesc: Two-factor is currently enabled. Confirm your password to disable — this rotates the authenticator secret.
settings.activeSessionsDesc: Every browser or device currently signed into your account. Revoking a session signs that device out within ~10 seconds.
settings.otherSessionOne: {n} other session is active. Sign them all out at once if you suspect an account compromise.
settings.otherSessionMany: {n} other sessions are active. Sign them all out at once if you suspect an account compromise.
settings.noSessions: No active sessions found. (Including this one? That would be a bug — please refresh.)
settings.pasteHint: Direct link to an image you host elsewhere.
settings.noPublicUrl: Server returned no public URL for this file.

common.notFoundBody: We couldn't find anything at that address. It may be a stale link, a renamed route, or a path that never existed.
common.goBack: Go back to the previous page
common.forbiddenTitle: You don't hold the permissions to view this surface.
common.forbiddenBody: Ask a root-tenant operator to grant the permissions below to a role you hold.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Operate every tenant on this instance — identity, multitenancy, billing, and the rest of the system surface.
dashboard.invoicesDesc: Cross-tenant ledger. Issue, mark paid, void.

tenants.emptyBody: Provision the first tenant to get started.
tenants.impersonateTitle: Sign in as a user inside this tenant
tenants.renewTitle: Extend validity by one plan term, or switch plans
tenants.adjustTitle: Set the expiry date directly with no invoice (operator override)
tenants.deactivateBody: Users of {name} will be blocked from signing in and all their API requests will be rejected until you reactivate the tenant.
tenants.activateBody: {name}'s users will be able to sign in and use the platform again.
tenants.detailsDesc: The tenant's identity, contact, and subscription window. Identifiers are immutable; the issuer scopes JWTs to this tenant.
tenants.name: Name
tenants.provisioningDesc: Live status of the background pipeline that seeds the tenant database, default roles, and admin user. Polls every 2 seconds while running.
tenants.notTrackedBody: This tenant wasn't created through the provisioning pipeline, so there's no run history to show. Tenants created via the console report their seed/migrate steps here.
tenants.createDesc: Provision a tenant and its seed admin. The identifier is the URL-safe slug used in routing and JWT claims.
tenants.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. 3–64 characters.
tenants.idValid: Valid format — availability is confirmed when you create.
tenants.idPattern: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. 3–64 chars. No leading/trailing hyphen.
tenants.passwordHint: The first admin signs in with this and can rotate it after first login.
tenants.planLoadFailed: Could not load plans — the tenant will fall back to the default plan.
tenants.planHint: Sets the first invoice and how long the tenant stays valid. Defaults to the trial plan.
tenants.issuerHint: Mirrors the identifier by default. Issued in tokens to scope sessions.
tenants.connectionHint: Optional. Leave blank to use the shared catalog database.
tenants.createdBody: Provisioning runs in the background. Track progress on the detail page.
tenants.previewNote: Provisioning runs in the background. You can track progress on the tenant's detail page.
tenants.renewDesc: Extend the tenant by one plan term (stacking on remaining time) or switch plans. Currently valid until {date}.
tenants.switchPlanHint: Switching plans — the new plan applies from this renewal forward.
tenants.samePlanHint: Renewing the current plan extends validity by one term.
tenants.renewedUntil: Valid until {date}. A term invoice was issued.
tenants.adjustDesc: Set this tenant's expiry date directly — an operator override with no invoice. Use for comps or corrections; renewals that should bill belong in Renew. Currently valid until {date}.
tenants.adjustHint: Backdating is allowed. No invoice is issued for an adjustment.
tenants.adjustedUntil: Valid until {date}. No invoice was issued.
tenants.brandingLoadDesc: Operator-controlled colors + brand assets that drive this tenant's UI.
tenants.brandingDesc: Theme tokens consumed by this tenant's apps on sign-in. Live preview reflects the primary action with the chosen palette.
tenants.brandAssetsHint: URLs to your hosted brand assets. Upload via the Files module first, then paste the resulting public URL here.
